title: AudioDesignResult
description: Final mixed video with audio-design applied. Pure domain data; flat shape so the frontend renders a single-video player with metadata.

description.description: One-liner summary, e.g. '12 cues · 2m 04s · video mode · ok'.

video_url.description: Final mp4 with audio-design applied (master mixed in, original video stream copied).

master_audio_url.description: Standalone mixed audio track (mp3 / wav). Optional.

duration.description: Total duration in seconds (matches input video).

cue_counts.description: Per-category cue count, e.g. {AMB: 3, BGM: 2, SFX: 5, STINGER: 1}.

failed_cues.description: IDs of cues that could not be rendered; surface for follow-up.

cue_corrections.description: Per-cue corrections applied during mix (truncation, bed conflict resolution, etc.).

transcript_source.description: Where the cue plan originated (transcript file id / Phase 02 artifact ref).
